title: Fusion-stable endosplit $p$-permutation resolutions
summary: Let $k$ be a field of characteristic $p>0$, $\mathcal{F}$ a saturated fusion system over a finite $p$-group $P$, and $V$ an indecomposable capped endopermutation $kP$-module. Let $D_k^Ω(P)$ be the subgroup of the Dade group $D_k(P)$ generated by all the relative syzygies. It is known that $V$ has an endosplit $p$-permutation resolution if and only if the Dade class $[V]$ belongs to $D_k^Ω(P)$.
